# AdrenoTools

Vendored from https://github.com/bylaws/libadrenotools at
`8fae8ce254dfc1344527e05301e43f37dea2df80`, with liblinkernsbypass at
`aa3975893d83ef1bc84c321ec60c65fbf1287887`. BSD-2-Clause licenses are retained.
Source is unmodified. Optional custom Vulkan driver loading only; normal APKs
do not build or package this dependency. See android/tools/build_adrenotools.py.
